description: Send a rich Telegram preview on artist submission: a photo message (artist image + all artist-provided text + profile link as caption), followed by separate audio messages for voice-mail + 2 tracks. Maximise information in the first message.

steps.task: Create a new async function `send_artist_preview` in telegram_notify.rs that fetches the Artist row from DB, generates presigned URLs, and sends the rich preview

sub_plan.description: Build the rich notification function step by step

steps.task: Add import for teloxide::types::InputFile, teloxide::requests::Requester, and crate::{models, storage}

learnings: teloxide 0.13 — InputFile::url() accepts a reqwest::Url for sending remote files by URL.
send_photo() takes InputFile and has .caption() and .parse_mode() builders.

steps.task: Implement `async fn send_artist_preview(state, artist_id)` — fetch Artist from DB, build caption, generate presigned URLs, send photo + audio messages

decisions: Query the artist row by ID — all text fields and R2 keys are in the artists table.
Use storage::get_presigned_url() for image and audio URLs (1h expiry — much more than Telegram needs to fetch).
Voice mail (if present) sent first as audio, then track1, then track2.
All audio messages should be reply-to the photo message to keep the thread grouped.
learnings: Telegram photo caption limit is 1024 chars. If the caption exceeds 1024, truncate gracefully.
InputFile::url() requires a url::Url, which we can parse from the presigned URL string.

steps.task: Build the HTML caption string: 🎤 name (pronouns), track names, socials (IG/SC/BC/Spotify), mentions, upcoming events, music description, then clickable profile link. HTML-escape user text to avoid breaking Telegram's parser.

decisions: Include all artist-provided text fields (not ai_bio, not instagram_caption — those are AI-generated).
Order: name+pronouns, track names, music_description, socials block, mentions, upcoming_events, then profile link at the bottom.
Use <b> for labels, plain text for values. Keep it readable.
HTML-escape &, <, > in user-provided text to avoid Telegram parse errors.
learnings: Artist text fields from submission: name, pronouns, track1_name, track2_name, instagram, soundcloud, bandcamp, spotify, other_social, upcoming_events, mentions, music_description.
Fields that are NOT user-provided and should be excluded: ai_bio, instagram_caption, instagram_posted_at, status, created_at, updated_at, all *_key fields.

decisions: Telegram API constraint: photo+caption is one message (max 1024 char caption). Audio files must be separate messages. Best strategy: 1 photo message with all text, then up to 3 audio messages.
Use reply_to_message_id on audio messages to keep them visually grouped with the photo in the chat.

steps.task: Replace the current notify_artist_submission to call send_artist_preview instead, with a fallback to the simple text notification if the artist row or presigned URLs fail

decisions: If send_artist_preview errors (DB unavailable, presigned URL fails, etc.), fall back to the current simple HTML text notification so we never lose notifications entirely.

steps.task: Handle the chunked-upload timing issue: in submit_chunked.rs the notification fires before background processing completes (files still in pending/). Either defer sending or use the pending keys for presigned URLs.

decisions: Best approach: move the notify call into finalize_artist_files_background() after files are moved and the DB is updated. This way all R2 keys in the artist row are final and presigned URLs work.
If finalization fails (status='processing_failed'), still send a simple text notification so the admin knows something came in.
Alternative considered (use pending keys) — rejected because pending keys are temporary and may be cleaned up.
learnings: submit.rs (non-chunked) has final keys at notification time — no change needed there.
submit_chunked.rs inserts with status='processing', spawns background, then immediately notifies. The background task calls finalize_artist_files_background() which moves files and updates DB.

steps.task: cargo check — verify compilation succeeds with no new errors

learnings: cargo check passes with only pre-existing warnings (dead_code in audio.rs, db.rs, models.rs).
